title: Another attack on Trump ? A post analysis of the White House correspondents' dinner shooting
summary: President Donald Trump and other officials had to be evacuated from the White House press correspondents' dinner after a man tried to break in with guns.
contentText: US President Donald Trump and other top officials had to be evacuated from the White House press correspondents' dinner on Saturday after a man tried to break in with guns. We speak to Richard Kolko, a former FBI supervisory special agent.
